scientific_protocol.inheritance: bit-identical v3 scientific protocol, which inherits the hash-pinned v2 source/features/partition/campaign/model/interval/gate policy

versioned_delta.remote_requirement: observed HEAD must be an ancestor of origin/feat/sota-foundation
versioned_delta.protocol_commit: exactly one ancestor with subject preregister L0 surrogate v4 experiment
versioned_delta.protocol_commit_path_policy: commit introduces every tracked v4 protocol file and no path outside v4 source/tests
versioned_delta.working_tree_policy: all v4 protocol paths byte-identical to observed HEAD with no untracked files
versioned_delta.intervening_commit_policy: unrelated pushed commits allowed; any intervening v4 protocol change rejected
versioned_delta.caller_expected_head_policy: optional expected SHA must exist and exactly equal observed HEAD
versioned_delta.recording: record observed HEAD, protocol content commit, protocol tree hash and remote ref before real-data access

preflight.serialization: inherit v3 atomic output pipeline and complete synthetic dry run

claims.allowed: deterministic L0 software-emulation metrics only when Git identity is valid
claims.forbidden: physical, experimental, L1, L1b, L2 or L3 accuracy
